Provision saga

A saga-style workflow that provisions an instance, attaches a volume and boots it — each step an activity. Pick a step to inject a failure into and run: the workflow compensates (rolls back) the steps that already succeeded, which you can watch unfold in the event history below.

  • main
  • provision with state machine
  • provision saga
  • child workflows

Requirements


(ns intemporal.provision-saga
  (:require [promesa.core :as p]
            [intemporal.core :as intemporal]
            [hiccups.runtime :as hiccupsrt])
  (:require-macros [hiccups.core :as hiccups :refer [html]]
                   [intemporal.core :refer [defn-workflow]]
                   [intemporal.internal.context :refer [bthen]]))

Activities

maybe-fail! throws when its step matches the selected failure injection, so you can force any step to fail. 


(defn provision-instance! []  (maybe-fail! :provision) {:instance-id "i-demo"})
(defn attach-volume! [inst]   (maybe-fail! :attach)    {:volume-id "vol-demo"})
(defn boot-vm! [inst vol]     (maybe-fail! :boot)      {:status :booted})

;; compensations (undo)
(defn halt-vm! [inst]         {:status :halted})
(defn detach-volume! [vol]    {:status :detached})
(defn deprovision! [inst]     {:status :deprovisioned})

Workflow — sequential steps with LIFO compensation

The happy path reads as a straight sequence of API calls. After each destructive step succeeds, a compensation thunk is registered. Any failure runs compensations in reverse (LIFO), undoing completed steps. No state machine, no signals — the workflow is just code. 


(defn-workflow run-provision-saga []
  (let [s         (intemporal/saga)
        provision (intemporal/stub #'provision-instance!)
        attach    (intemporal/stub #'attach-volume!)
        boot      (intemporal/stub #'boot-vm!)
        halt      (intemporal/stub #'halt-vm!)
        detach    (intemporal/stub #'detach-volume!)
        depr      (intemporal/stub #'deprovision!)]
    (try
      (let [inst (provision)
            _    (intemporal/add-compensation s #(depr (:instance-id inst)))
            vol  (attach (:instance-id inst))
            _    (intemporal/add-compensation s #(detach (:volume-id vol)))]
        (boot (:instance-id inst) (:volume-id vol))
        {:status :booted :instance-id (:instance-id inst)})
      (catch js/Error e
        (intemporal/compensate s)                 ; undo in reverse order
        (throw e)))))

Execution


(defn run-demo! []
  (reset! fail-at (scenario-from-select))          ; which step to fail
  (let [engine (intemporal/start-engine :owner-id "doc-provision-saga"
                                        :threads 4 :enable-logging true)]
    (-> (intemporal/start-workflow engine run-provision-saga [] :workflow-id wf-id)
        (bthen  (fn [res] (set-results! (prn-str res)) (render-tables! engine)))
        (p/catch (fn [err] (set-results! (str "Error: " (ex-message err)))
                           (render-tables! engine))))
        (p/finally #(intemporal/shutdown-engine engine)))))
